description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalaryService class, which provides a service layer for handling employee salary data within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes dependency management and a getter for the associated Data Access Object (DAO).

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing employee salary operations, encapsulating dependency on EmployeeSalaryDao, and providing access to it.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaryDao
methods.description: Provides access to the EmployeeSalaryDao instance, creating it if it does not already exist.
